body:
## Symptom

In a recent run, the MainAgent loop emitted ~13 `WARNING [agents.main_agent] MainAgent emitted text-only response; nudging back to tool use` lines after the agent had finished its task and was idling. Sample text-only turns:

```
"The workspace is complete and the DONE.txt lock is active. No further sub-tasks remain..."
"All goals are fully met. I am issuing standby tool calls to satisfy the system loop constraints..."
"The DONE.txt lock remains active. Waiting for system stop."
```

Each of these triggered the nudge. The nudge text — *"Your previous turn had no function_call — every step must be a tool call."* — is misleading in this context: the agent isn't malfunctioning, it's idling because the prompt has `# Termination` set to "no termination in software". The agent has nowhere to go.

## Root cause: two distinct issues

### 1. The nudge can't distinguish "agent is idling after finishing" from "agent drifted into narrative mode"

`agents/main_agent.py:152-164` fires unconditionally on any text-only response. Two scenarios produce text-only turns and the current code treats them identically:

- **Legitimate idle** (e.g. agent has submitted final artifacts, is spinning waiting for the user). Nudging is wrong here — the agent literally has nothing productive to do. We see ~13 of these in the trailing 5–10 minutes of the observed run.
- **Drift / "verbal commitment without action"** — model emits *"let me investigate the foo"* and forgets to attach a function_call. This is a real failure mode that the nudge currently catches and corrects. Removing the nudge entirely loses this safety net.

### 2. The nudge is invisible in the JSONL chat log

`_step()` calls `self._log({"role": "assistant", ...})` for the model's text-only turn (line 150) but the synthetic user-nudge appended at line 156-163 goes to `self.input_list` only — `self._log` is never called for it. Result: the JSONL transcript shows only `assistant` and `tool` records (verified: `roles = {'assistant': 392, 'tool': 389}`, zero user records across 781 records of a real run), even though Gemini saw a sequence of `assistant → user (nudge) → assistant → user (nudge) → ...`.

This breaks the viewer (#286 / #290) — the rendered transcript will diverge from what the LLM actually consumed, and a debugger can't see why the model "suddenly" started producing tool calls again after a text-only turn.

## Proposal

Replace the unconditional nudge with a counter-based smart nudge:

```python
if not has_function_calls:
    self._consecutive_text_only += 1
    if self._consecutive_text_only >= _TEXT_ONLY_NUDGE_THRESHOLD:
        nudge = append_message("user", _NUDGE_TEXT)
        self.input_list.append(nudge)
        self._log({"role": "user", "content": nudge})  # also log this time
        self._consecutive_text_only = 0
    return
else:
    self._consecutive_text_only = 0
# ... rest of dispatch
```

Threshold = 2 (single "let me investigate" or single "done" passes through unmolested; back-to-back fires the correction). Mirrors the existing `_STUCK_REPEAT_THRESHOLD` infrastructure for repeated identical tool calls.

Three benefits:
1. Single legitimate text-only (idle, transient drift) → no log noise, no fake user message.
2. Sustained narrative mode → the nudge still fires before the run goes off the rails.
3. JSONL transcript reflects what the model actually saw — fixes the silent-divergence bug for the viewer.

## Out of scope

- A real termination signal (text-only = stop the run). Different design discussion — `# Termination` is currently load-bearing in the prompt and changing it has knock-on effects.
title: MainAgent text-only nudge: fires on legitimate done turns + isn't logged to JSONL
